mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every connected equal-normalized-defect circuit cluster admits one common-witness deletion or circuit subtractions that decompose it into petal-only clusters with strictly smaller overlap rank; the resulting total repair is O(1) per disjoint packed circuit.
mechanisms.kill_test: Test a chain and a cycle of equal-defect circuits with pairwise different overlap vertices; reject if subtraction preserves both defect and overlap rank without a reusable deletion.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: After stratifying a failure cluster by normalized cardinality defect, the sum of minimal hitting costs of all strata is o(log N) per packed circuit because nonzero-defect subtraction moves strictly toward zero and the zero stratum has a common-witness contraction.
mechanisms.kill_test: Build mixed-defect path books with no global common witness and track whether defect differences can oscillate or regenerate an old stratum.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The subtraction-closed arithmetic cluster hypergraph has integrality gap o(log N) relative to the log-defect fractional cover, certified by a dual depending only on circuit packing, petal reuse, and defect labels.
mechanisms.kill_test: Reject if dual feasibility is equivalent to assigning weight at least one to every original bad support, or if private-satellite iterates give a logarithmic gap after cross-cluster deletions.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: There is a cluster boundary coarea ordering whose total exposed repair boundary is O(log log N) times disjoint-circuit packing weight uniformly over all subtraction-closed arithmetic clusters.
mechanisms.kill_test: Compute exposed boundary on recursively nested core-satellite books and on equal-defect overlap chains; demand an all-depth telescoping inequality.

mechanisms.initial_sketch: Choose an extremal full-residue top transition and seek O(log log N) repeated owner charge; the falsification phase froze the first noncircular realization as O_top below.
mechanisms.decisive_claim: For the explicit O_top rule that retains the largest prime and complete reduced cofactor ratio U/V and selects the extremal top-fibre term on the larger residue side, the set of distinct owners is bounded by g(N) sum_n w_N(n)+o(N) for some g(N)=o(log N).
mechanisms.kill_test: Test O_top on odd squarefree double stars sharing the vertex 2; reject if the owner set has positive density although one deletion repairs the whole book.

mechanisms.round4_survivor_refinement: The current must be defined on the subtraction-closed cluster quotient and retain normalized defect and common-cluster geometry; the two residue-only owners in ROUND4_FULL_RESIDUE_OWNER_FLOW are closed.
mechanisms.decisive_claim: A conserved signed divisor current on the subtraction-closed full-residue cluster quotient admits a scale-conductance inequality that pays one unit for every failure cluster while its aggregate vertex energy is o(log N) times the log-defect fractional mass.
mechanisms.kill_test: Test long degree-two paths, common-root books, and the equal-defect projective-plane cluster; reject if the current ignores cluster intersections, if unit flow has arbitrarily small energy, or if dual feasibility restates the original transversal constraints.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A harmonic randomized owner chosen from the complete cofactor-residue support has expected distinct-owner congestion O(log log N), and alteration of the randomized owner set preserves all bad-support coverage.
mechanisms.kill_test: Test correlated RR.2 books sharing numerator or denominator residues; reject any independence assumption or owner selection that can leave a circuit ownerless.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The integral over logarithmic prime scales of signed residue-support boundary decreases by at least one over every complete propagation component and has initial mass O(log log N) per packed circuit.
mechanisms.kill_test: Place RR.1 edge primes in one narrow allowed scale interval and test whether unbounded propagation has bounded initial coarea but no strict total decrease.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A convex energy of multiplicities of identical signed cofactor states amortizes every split against a later merge, giving O(log log N) total charge per connected failure cluster.
mechanisms.kill_test: Construct a branching double-star tree with private residues so every transition splits into new states and no later merge occurs.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: After deleting the o(N) low-Omega host, the large full-occurrence cycle rank in RR.3 yields enough independent circuit eliminations that one repair can be reused for Omega(log log N) fractional units, producing an o(log N) rounding loss.
mechanisms.kill_test: Build minimal high-Omega relations whose occurrence cycles all project through distinct integer vertices; reject if cycle-space dimension does not imply shared repair.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Finite transversals can be chosen on dyadic cutoffs so that extension from 2^k to 2^(k+1) changes at most eta_k 2^k old decisions with sum eta_k finite and adds o(2^k) deletions; the limit set is admissible and has natural density one.
mechanisms.kill_test: Apply future RR.2 completions to arbitrary admitted lower pairs; demand a unique-scale charge proving summable recourse rather than pointwise convergence only.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A rapidly growing block construction with multiplicative guard zones converts arbitrary finite o(N) transversals into one compatible infinite transversal of zero density while controlling density at every intermediate endpoint.
mechanisms.kill_test: Construct cross-block equal-product relations using one later prime and old lower factors; reject unless every such relation necessarily meets a guard zone of summable total density.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: For every integer Q>=2, with the explicit periodic baseline B_Q={1} union {n:Q divides n}, the B_Q-disjoint residual hypergraphs admit transversals T_k of size o(2^k) whose adjacent old-prefix changes satisfy |C_k intersect X_j|<=rho_k 2^j for all j<=k with sum rho_k finite; CR.1 then gives an admissible set of natural density 1-1/Q.
mechanisms.kill_test: Apply MC.1 to seeds outside B_Q and the toggle-prefix obstruction; reject endpoint-only recourse, non-explicit reserves, or any B that already encodes a full infinite transversal.
